summary.text: Dick Anderson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 6 (Willow City) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Dick Anderson's service as "House since 2011". The member page lists Dick Anderson's committee assignments as including Energy and Natural Resources (Vice Chair) and the Finance and Taxation standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Dick Anderson's occupation as Farmer.
It lists education as BA, Personnel Management, UND.
Dick Anderson is listed as married to Sue with 2 children.
